Create dataset from sf object.

Source: R/method_Dataset.R
create_dataset_from_sf.Rd

Create a Dataset object from a sf::st_sf() object.

Usage

create_dataset_from_sf(x, boundary_data = NULL)

Arguments

x

sf::st_sf() object.

boundary_data

Matrix::sparseMatrix() object with boundary data. Defaults to NULL such that the boundary data are calculated automatically.

Value

A Dataset object.

See also

Other functions for calling class methods: create_legend(), create_solution(), create_solution_from_prioritization(), create_solution_legend(), create_tile_from_file(), create_tile_from_project(), create_tile_from_sf(), new_dataset(), tool_generated_provenance()

Examples

# simulate spatial data
sim_data <- simulate_spatial_data()

# create object
x <- create_dataset_from_sf(sim_data)

# preview object
print(x)
